scripts.build: npm run build -w @monde/core && npm run build -w @monde/adapters && npm run build -w @monde/service && npm run build -w @monde/cli && npm run build -w @monde/web
scripts.check: npm run build -w @monde/core && npm run build -w @monde/adapters && npm run check --workspaces --if-present
scripts.dev:service: npm run build -w @monde/core && npm run dev -w @monde/service
scripts.dev:all: npm run dev:service & npm run dev:web
scripts.monde: npm run build -w @monde/core && npm run dev -w @monde/cli --
scripts.smoke:all: npm run test && npm run smoke:ci
scripts.smoke:ci: npm run build && MONDE_SMOKE_SKIP_BUILD=1 npm run smoke:vertical-slice-1 && MONDE_SMOKE_SKIP_BUILD=1 npm run smoke:local-alpha && MONDE_SMOKE_SKIP_BUILD=1 npm run smoke:harness-alpha && MONDE_SMOKE_SKIP_BUILD=1 npm run smoke:harness-beta && MONDE_SMOKE_SKIP_BUILD=1 npm run smoke:write-evidence && MONDE_SMOKE_SKIP_BUILD=1 npm run smoke:beta-review
scripts.smoke:external: npm run build && MONDE_SMOKE_SKIP_BUILD=1 MONDE_ENABLE_EXTERNAL_CODEX_SMOKE=1 bash scripts/smoke-harness-beta.sh && MONDE_SMOKE_SKIP_BUILD=1 bash scripts/smoke-codex-write.sh
